ns2:course.label: Harnessing Your Interpersonal Intelligence
ns2:course.description: Students will expand their capacity for communication, collaboration and team leadership to navigate the complexities of the university and beyond. In this course, students will learn communication strategies to work with others and practice self-awareness, self-management, and interpersonal communication skills in a supportive setting to reach their personal potential as emerging leaders. Same as LEAD 140. Prerequisite: Freshman, Sophomore, or Junior Standing Required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as LEAD 140. Prerequisite: Freshman, Sophomore, or Junior Standing Required.
